extracted.intended_audience: government communicators (MCOM) and Government Communication Service staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for MCOM (ministerial communications) teams on strategic communications across policy and operational crises, describing stages of problems and appropriate communication interventions (diagnosis, agreed diagnosis, delivery, assessment and learning).

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and operational diagnosis (Strategic communications advice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and operational diagnosis (Strategic communications advice)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a stage in the 'Policy operations crisis problem stages (and communication interventions)'. Implies providing strategic communications advice during the initial policy/operational diagnosis phase of a crisis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreed diagnosis (Communication diagnosis)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a stage in the 'Policy operations crisis problem stages (and communication interventions)'. Implies establishing a shared diagnosis between policy/operational leads and communicators to inform communications strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and operational delivery (Operational and delivery communication)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and operational delivery (Operational and delivery communication)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a stage in the 'Policy operations crisis problem stages (and communication interventions)'. Refers to communications activity aligned with policy and operational delivery during implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment and learning (Strategic communications guidance)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a stage in the 'Policy operations crisis problem stages (and communication interventions)'. Covers post-implementation assessment and learning to inform future strategic communications guidance.
